title: Save/Load and Persistence (local-first)
description:
Purpose: Local-first save of mission progress, construct unlocks, settings, and comfort prefs. Auto-save on mission completion and recharge events. Manual save from Wrist Menu.

API:
- Save(slot:string="auto"): writes JSON state to local storage.
- Load(slot): restores state and broadcasts events to consumers.
- RegisterSection(id, serialize_fn, deserialize_fn): let modules contribute to save payloads.

Triggers:
- Mission completion (from mission_system).
- Recharge completion (from promoted.ring_charge_and_recharge).
- Manual save (Wrist Menu button).

Acceptance hooks:
- test_save_persistence.

Suggested file split: persistence_register.cpp, persistence_storage.cpp, persistence_sections.cpp.
